text: Employees who have completed six months of service may apply for annual leave through the employee portal. Leave requests should be submitted to the reporting manager for approval.
label: leave_policy

text: Eligible employees receive twelve days of paid casual leave each calendar year. Unused casual leave is not carried forward to the next year.
label: leave_policy

text: Sick leave may be requested when an employee is unable to work due to illness. A medical certificate may be requested for extended absence.
label: leave_policy

text: Maternity and parental leave are provided in accordance with applicable law and the organization's leave procedures. Employees should contact HR before the planned leave period.
label: leave_policy

text: Annual leave should be planned with the team lead so that business operations are adequately covered during the employee's absence.
label: leave_policy

text: A leave cancellation request must be submitted through the HR portal and approved by the reporting manager before the original leave dates.
label: leave_policy

text: Employees joining during the year receive a prorated leave balance based on their date of joining and applicable company policy.
label: leave_policy

text: Public holidays are announced by HR at the beginning of each calendar year. A holiday falling during approved annual leave is handled according to the leave rules.
label: leave_policy

text: Leave without pay may be considered when paid leave balances are exhausted, subject to manager approval and HR review.
label: leave_policy

text: Employees should check their available leave balance before submitting a request. The portal displays approved, pending, and remaining leave days.
label: leave_policy

text: Business travel expenses must be recorded in the expense portal with itemized receipts. Claims should be submitted within thirty days of returning from travel.
label: expense_claim

text: Employees may claim reimbursement for approved business meals up to the limits in the travel and expense schedule. Personal purchases are not reimbursable.
label: expense_claim

text: Taxi fares are reimbursable when public transport is unavailable or when travel is required outside normal operating hours, provided a receipt is attached.
label: expense_claim

text: A manager must approve travel expenses before the trip is booked. Reimbursement requests without the required approval may be returned.
label: expense_claim

text: Expense claims must include the date, business purpose, cost centre, amount, and supporting receipt for each transaction.
label: expense_claim

text: The finance team reviews submitted claims and may request additional documentation before processing payment.
label: expense_claim

text: Employees using a personal vehicle for approved business travel may claim mileage at the rate published by Finance.
label: expense_claim

text: Hotel accommodation should follow the approved city-wise limits. Any exception requires written approval from the department head.
label: expense_claim

text: Corporate card transactions must be reconciled monthly. Employees should identify the business purpose for each transaction in the expense system.
label: expense_claim

text: Reimbursements are normally paid through payroll or the designated payment process after Finance completes its review.
label: expense_claim

text: Employees must record their start time, end time, and breaks using the attendance system each working day.
label: attendance_policy

text: The standard office schedule is Monday to Friday. Employees should follow the working hours assigned to their team and location.
label: attendance_policy

text: If an employee expects to arrive late, they should notify their manager and record the correct attendance information in the system.
label: attendance_policy

text: Any correction to a missed attendance punch must be submitted through the attendance portal with a brief explanation.
label: attendance_policy

text: Overtime must be approved by the manager in advance and recorded in the timekeeping system for review.
label: attendance_policy

text: Employees are expected to maintain accurate attendance records. Repeated unexplained absences may be referred to HR.
label: attendance_policy

text: Shift-based employees must follow the roster published by their supervisor. Shift swaps require prior approval.
label: attendance_policy

text: The attendance period closes at the end of each month. Employees should resolve pending corrections before the monthly cutoff.
label: attendance_policy

text: Short breaks and meal periods should be taken according to the schedule applicable to the employee's location and team.
label: attendance_policy

text: Employees working at a client site must follow the site attendance process and also notify their internal manager of exceptions.
label: attendance_policy

text: Eligible employees may work remotely on approved days after agreeing on availability and deliverables with their manager.
label: remote_work

text: Employees working from home must protect company information and use approved devices, networks, and security controls.
label: remote_work

text: Remote employees should remain reachable during agreed core hours and attend scheduled team meetings using approved collaboration tools.
label: remote_work

text: A remote work arrangement may be reviewed when role requirements, performance needs, or business conditions change.
label: remote_work

text: Employees must report any loss of a company device used outside the office to IT and their manager as soon as possible.
label: remote_work

text: Confidential documents should not be printed or left visible in shared spaces when an employee is working remotely.
label: remote_work

text: Managers should agree measurable outcomes with remote team members and review progress during regular one-to-one meetings.
label: remote_work

text: Employees planning to work from another city or country must obtain written approval before making the arrangement.
label: remote_work

text: Video calls should be conducted from a suitable environment where confidential conversations cannot be overheard.
label: remote_work

text: Remote work does not change the employee's responsibility to follow working hours, attendance, and information security policies.
label: remote_work

text: Open positions must have an approved requisition before a recruiter begins advertising or sourcing candidates.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Candidate applications should be reviewed against the published role requirements using consistent and job-related criteria.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Interviewers must submit structured feedback through the recruitment system promptly after each interview.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Recruiters should obtain candidate consent before sharing personal information with external assessment providers.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Employment offers must be approved by the hiring manager and HR before they are sent to a selected candidate.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Background verification is conducted for selected candidates in accordance with applicable law and the organization's hiring process.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Interview questions should relate to the role and must not seek information that is unrelated to the candidate's ability to perform the job.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Recruitment records should be retained and accessed only by authorized employees for legitimate hiring purposes.
label: recruitment_policy

text: A hiring manager should document the reason for selecting a candidate and retain interview feedback in the recruitment system.
label: recruitment_policy

text: Internal candidates may apply for advertised vacancies through the same recruitment portal and selection process.
label: recruitment_policy
